summary: Iteration 352 - DRY Refactor: Resource Hierarchy Helpers VERIFIED. All 26 tests PASSED (12 new iter352 tests + 14 iter351 regression tests). The refactor correctly extracts splittable-parent + sub-room expansion logic into services/resource_hierarchy.py with expand_blocking_ids() and child_to_parent_map() helpers. Behavior is byte-identical to iter 351.

check_conflicts_parent.description: POST /api/resources/{parent_id}/check-conflicts with children booked returns conflicts from children's bookings.

check_conflicts_child.description: POST /api/resources/{child_id}/check-conflicts includes parent scope (returns 0 when no parent bookings).

check_conflicts_buffer.description: POST /api/resources/{parent_id}/check-conflicts with buffer_time: parent-buffer is still respected via expand_blocking_ids helper.

availability_only_child.description: GET /api/resource-bookings?resource_id={child_id}&availability_only=true returns own bookings + parent bookings.

availability_snapshot.description: GET /api/resource-availability-snapshot: parent shows next_busy when only children are booked (iter 351 behaviour preserved).

non_splittable_resources.description: Non-splittable resources: check_conflicts/availability_only return original results unchanged (no fake parent/child expansion).

race_condition_winner.description: Race-condition winner selection still works (verify_booking_winner uses a different code path, not affected).

end_to_end_booking_flow.description: End-to-end: create booking -> conflict check -> update -> cancel still works.

resource_hierarchy_integration.description: Verified expand_blocking_ids and child_to_parent_map are correctly integrated in all 3 call sites.

iter351_regression.description: All 14 iter351 tests pass - backward compatibility confirmed.

code_review.services/resource_hierarchy.py: NEW module with expand_blocking_ids(resource_id) -> (ids, resource, buffer_min) and child_to_parent_map() -> {child_id: parent_id}. Clean implementation with proper docstrings. Rules are kept verbatim from original conflict-check.
code_review.services/booking_conflicts.py (lines 54-: Now imports and uses expand_blocking_ids from resource_hierarchy. Clean integration.
code_review.routes/resources/bookings/crud.py (lines: availability_only block now uses expand_blocking_ids for parent/child expansion. Correct implementation.
code_review.routes/resources/admin/analytics.py (lin: availability_snapshot uses child_to_parent_map for folding children into parent. Correct implementation.

critical_code_review_comments: DRY refactor is correct: 3 call sites now share single source of truth for parent/child expansion logic
expand_blocking_ids correctly handles: (1) resource itself, (2) parent if child, (3) children if splittable parent, (4) buffer_time max of own and parent

Behavior is byte-identical to iter 351 - all 14 regression tests pass
